justification: Access control on a paid product route; money and abuse exposure

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the route forwards a request without a paid conveyancing session for this report_id, or uses an address from the request body
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main frontend-nextjs/app/api/reports/conveyancing/generate/route.ts has no payment, token or report check (read 2026-10-19): a POST with any report_id/address/lat/lng is forwarded to Railway. The new Jest file's 'refuses a request with no checkout session' case returns 200-path on main (route forwards) and 400 here.

pre_impl.existing_data: Stripe checkout session metadata set by app/api/stripe/checkout/conveyancing (report_id, address, product, lat, lng, prop_id)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a session created before lat/lng were added to metadata returns 422 instead of a PDF
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: applies to every conveyancing PDF generation request after this deploy, from the webhook

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the route forwards a request without a paid conveyancing session for this report_id, or uses an address from the request body
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main frontend-nextjs/app/api/reports/conveyancing/generate/route.ts has no payment, token or report check (read 2026-10-19): a POST with any report_id/address/lat/lng is forwarded to Railway. The new Jest file's 'refuses a request with no checkout session' case returns 200-path on main (route forwards) and 400 here.

pre_impl.external_source_error: stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve throws on an unknown id or network error; caught and answered 403
pre_impl.frontend_type: no frontend type change; the webhook is the only caller
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: a paying customer whose session lacks lat/lng gets no PDF email; the webhook logs the 422

functions.name: POST
functions.input: report_id and checkout_session_id sent by the Stripe webhook handler after payment
functions.output: Railway PDF URL, or 400/403/422 with no PDF made
functions.if_none: a missing session id or report id returns 400 before any Stripe call

break_it.scenario: attacker replays a real paid session id for another report
break_it.what_happens: the attacker would receive a second report's paid PDF without paying for it
break_it.how: metadata.report_id must equal the requested report_id

break_it.scenario: attacker sends a paid session but their own address
break_it.what_happens: would get a PDF for an address they did not pay for
break_it.how: address and coordinates are read only from session metadata
break_it.repro: jest 'paid session generates, using the address from the session'

break_it.scenario: the Stripe API is down or slow while the webhook calls this route
break_it.what_happens: no PDF is generated even though the customer has already paid
break_it.how: 403 returned and logged by the webhook; Stripe retries webhooks on non-2xx only if the webhook itself fails — needs manual resend
break_it.repro: block api.stripe.com and replay the webhook

break_it.scenario: someone sends a checkout session id that is unpaid or has expired
break_it.what_happens: a paid PDF would be made and sent without any payment at all

break_it.scenario: a session paid for a cheaper product such as a flood report is sent
break_it.what_happens: the cheaper purchase would unlock the more expensive conveyancing PDF for free

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — after deploy, a POST without checkout_session_id returns 400
